value: Positive funding > 0.1% per 8h = market overleveraged long. Negative funding < -0.05% = overleveraged short. Extreme funding (>0.3% or <-0.15%) is a contrarian signal.
Rising OI + rising price = trend continuation (strong longs entering). Rising OI + falling price = strong shorts entering. Falling OI = deleveraging; trend likely ending.
Large liquidation clusters above price = potential short-squeeze target. Below price = long-squeeze risk. Price often moves toward largest liquidity pool before reversing.
Every trade plan needs: entry trigger, stop-loss (invalidation), TP1 (partial close 50%), TP2 (full), position size (max 2% account risk per trade), and reason-to-cancel condition.

Higher-highs + higher-lows = uptrend. Lower-lows + lower-highs = downtrend. Break of structure (BOS) confirms new trend. Market structure shift (MSS) = potential reversal. Trade with structure not against it.
Diversification reduces unsystematic risk. Efficient frontier: maximum return for given risk. Sharpe ratio = (Return - Risk-free rate) / Standard deviation. Target Sharpe > 1.5 for active strategies.

Rebalance when: (1) allocation drifts >5-10% from target, (2) quarterly scheduled review, (3) major market move >20%. Tax-loss harvesting in Q4. Use new deposits to rebalance first (avoids taxable events).
Monitor: DXY (dollar strength), 10Y Treasury yield, Fed funds rate expectations (CME FedWatch), global PMI, credit spreads (HYG). Risk-on = DXY down, yields flat/down, PMI >50.

Sustainable APY = protocol revenue / TVL annualised. Incentivised APY from token emissions = impermanent inflation risk. Blue-chip protocols (Aave, Compound, Uniswap V3) vs new protocols: 10x risk differential.
Bitcoin halving cycle: accumulation (6-12m post-halving) → bull run (12-18m) → distribution → bear (-18-24m). On-chain metrics: MVRV >3.5 = overheated. NUPL <0 = fear/capitulation.
